instruction: Grab the playingcards with red packaging and move it outward.

source.instruction: Grab the playingcards with red packaging and move it outward.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the playingcards, which was at x = -9 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Orient left gripper downward, rotate yaw to match the card deck angle, and move closer toward the target.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-0, +11, -5) cm, now 24 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the playingcards

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -8, 89) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move left arm horizontally to align above the playing cards at (-9, 3, 85).
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+21, +11, -4) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +11 cm (vertical) from the playingcards

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-10, 3, 85) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower left arm to grasp height z=78 cm and close gripper onto the playing cards.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -7) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the playingcards; closed the gripper (opening 0.70: holding the playingcards)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-9, 3, 78) opening 0.70; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift cards up to z=88 cm and translate leftward toward x=-39 cm to move it outward.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (-30, -0, +10) cm, now 1 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the playingcards

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-39, 2, 88) opening 0.72; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower the playing cards back onto the table surface to z=78 cm.
frames.effect: LEFT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -10) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the playingcards

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-39, 2, 78) opening 0.72; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Open left gripper to release the cards and complete the task.
